latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Enhancer 4K v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Upscales low-resolution videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV) to 4K quality in 1–3 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB; optimized for content creators and YouTubers.
- Built-in session handling, free token acquisition, and 7-day trial credits for new users.
- Seamless workflows: upload, describe enhancements, preview timeline, and export 4K MP4.
- Includes robust error handling, guided setup, and clear mapping for common editing requests.
